_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV: QCT (cash machine) > QTL (royalty haut PV) > Auto (hyper) > IoT > Handsets (core mature).

kpis.signal: Pilier QCOM. Modems 5G mobile + Snapdragon + auto (Digital Chassis). Bascule vers IoT/Auto.
kpis.description_fr: QCT = chips business. Mobile handsets (75%), Auto (8%), IoT (17%). Croissance 2024-2025 Auto et IoT.
kpis.description_en: QCT = chip business. Mobile (75%), Auto (8%), IoT (17%). 2024-2025 Auto and IoT growth.

kpis.signal: Joyau marge. Royalties brevets 5G mondiaux. Marge segment >70%. Croissance modeste mais stable.
kpis.description_fr: Licensing portefeuille brevets 5G/CDMA. Marge segment >70%. ~5-6 Mds $ revenus récurrents.
kpis.description_en: 5G/CDMA patent portfolio licensing. >70% segment margin. ~$5-6B recurring revenue.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance Auto. Snapdragon Digital Chassis adopté par premium auto. Cible 8 Mds $ FY29.
kpis.description_fr: QCT automobile (Snapdragon Cockpit + Ride). Premium OEMs (BMW, Mercedes, Stellantis). Cible 8 Mds $.
kpis.description_en: QCT automotive (Snapdragon Cockpit + Ride). Premium OEMs (BMW, Mercedes, Stellantis). $8B target.

kpis.signal: Industrial IoT + PC Snapdragon X (laptops AI). Reprise progressive après destocking 2023.
kpis.description_fr: QCT IoT: industrial, edge devices, PC Snapdragon X (Windows Copilot+). Repris 2024-2025.
kpis.description_en: QCT IoT: industrial, edge devices, PC Snapdragon X (Windows Copilot+). Recovered 2024-2025.

kpis.signal: Core Mobile. Apple modem transition risque mais Samsung/Chinois dominent encore Snapdragon.
kpis.description_fr: Handsets Mobile (Samsung Galaxy, Chinois Xiaomi/OPPO). Risque Apple internalisation modem 5G.
kpis.description_en: Mobile handsets (Samsung Galaxy, Chinese Xiaomi/OPPO). Apple modem in-housing risk.

_notes: Qualcomm. Fiscal year ends end September. FY25 = year ended Sept 28, 2025.
